name: ILLUSIA-vita
description: Native PS Vita wrapper/port of Illusia, originally published by Gamevil for Android, built on soloader-boilerplate.
long_description: Native port of **ILLUSIA** (Android, `com.gamevil.illusia`, Gamevil **Nexus2** engine) to the PS Vita. It runs the original `libgameDSO.so` **unmodified** through a SoLoader + FalsoJNI bridge. No game logic was reimplemented: only the Android / JNI / OpenGL ES layer underneath it.
